runningPace.title: Running & Marathon Pace Calculator
runningPace.description: Calculate distance, time or pace, then compare up to 3 finish-time goals for the same distance. Share numeric settings and export all comparison splits as TSV, CSV or a print view.

error.distance: Distance must be greater than 0 and at most 500 km, with up to 4 decimal places.
error.time: Finish time must be positive, and minutes and seconds must each be 0–59.
error.pace: Pace must be positive, and seconds must be 0–59.

guide.title: How it works
guide.formula: Average pace (seconds/km) = finish time (seconds) ÷ distance (km), and speed (km/h) = 3,600 ÷ pace (seconds/km). To calculate time from pace, multiply distance by pace.
guide.splits: Cumulative splits use the original time and distance, not the rounded pace shown on screen. The final split ends at the full distance and target time. The comparison preview shows up to 50 rows per page; TSV, CSV and print include all splits, up to 500.
guide.note: This is an arithmetic comparison assuming a constant pace over the same distance. Goals keep their entered finish times when distance or mode changes, and invalid goals remain separate. It does not assess fitness, training effects or whether a goal is achievable.

faq.q: How many finish-time goals can I compare?
faq.a: Compare up to 3 goals for one distance. Add the current valid finish time rounded to seconds, or enter hours, minutes and seconds. Goals keep their finish times when distance or calculation mode changes.

faq.q: Does the final split match the target time?
faq.a: Cumulative splits use the original time-to-distance ratio, not a pace rounded for display. The remaining distance of a half or full marathon is included, and the final cumulative time matches the target.

faq.q: Can I export splits outside the current page?
faq.a: The preview shows up to 50 rows per page. TSV, CSV and print include every split for the settings captured by the click. A 500km distance with 1km splits produces 500 rows. Correct invalid goals before exporting.

faq.q: What does the share link contain?
faq.a: A versioned URL recreates numeric single-calculation settings and comparison goals. No saved list or account sync is added. These settings can be visible in browser history and to anyone receiving the link.

faq.q: Does this mean I can run at that pace?
faq.a: No. This is an arithmetic comparison for a constant pace over the same distance. It does not assess fitness, training effects or the likelihood of achieving a goal.

comparison.title: Compare finish-time goals
comparison.description: Compare pace and cumulative splits for up to 3 goals at the same distance. Goal finish times stay unchanged when you change distance or calculation mode.
comparison.limit: You can compare up to 3 goals. Remove a goal to add another.
comparison.secondsNotice: Comparison goals use whole seconds. The current finish time is rounded to the nearest second when added.
comparison.empty: Add the current result or enter goal hours, minutes and seconds.
comparison.invalidTime: Enter hours 0–99 and minutes/seconds 0–59. The goal must be at least 1 second.
comparison.invalidDistance: Enter a valid shared distance to calculate the comparison.
comparison.difference: Difference from the shortest valid goal
comparison.tableNotice: {total} splits in total. The screen shows up to 50 rows per page; TSV, CSV and printing include all splits.

addErrors.unavailable: Enter a valid distance and time or pace in the single calculation.
addErrors.belowOneSecond: The current finish time rounds to less than 1 second. Enter a comparison goal of at least 1 second.
addErrors.aboveClockRange: The current finish time exceeds the comparison limit of 99:59:59. The single result is unchanged.

export.invalid: The distance and every goal must be valid to export the complete comparison. Finish or remove incomplete goals.

query.invalid: The shared input format or range is invalid. The default example was not calculated as this link's result.
query.unsupported: This share-link version is unsupported. Edit the input or start with the default example.
query.tooLong: The address is too long, so link sharing is disabled. Download the full split table as CSV.
query.draft: Incomplete or invalid input caused earlier numeric conditions to be removed from the address. Complete every input to share a link.
query.writeFailed: The address could not be updated. Link sharing is disabled because it may contain earlier input.
query.notice: Links include the shared distance, active mode's numeric value, interval and goal times. Names and inactive-mode drafts are excluded.
